goal: 将已与 origin/main 对齐的代码完整部署到现有云服务器，刷新 PostgreSQL-only 数据 owner，清理部署重新带入的无效本地产物，并在不切换正式 Active Manifest 或 SimC runtime 的前提下留下可恢复、可核验的生产证据。
userValue: 线上代码与仓库最新实现一致，计划内数据 owner 获得新一轮真实刷新结果，运维人员可以区分已更新、partial 和仍受外部权威阻断的状态。
nonGoals: 不 promotion dormant Candidate，不修改 Active Manifest generation、release vector、rollback pointer 或用户接受边界。
不自动更新或切换 SimulationCraft runtime，不修改 SIMC_GITHUB_REPO、SIMC_BRANCH、timer cadence 或 source scope。
不安装依赖、不启用 SQLite fallback、不下载本地第三方资产、不把 HTTP 200 或 service exit 0 表述为全部数据 verified。
不删除正式 release evidence、PostgreSQL 恢复点、Exact-first foundation、Active/Candidate/rollback runtime 或未完成 owner 的有效运行数据。

currentTruth.factOwner: Git tracked file hashes own deployed code identity; PostgreSQL sync state and /api/data/health own data readiness; the formal Active Manifest pointer owns its dependency vector.

executionAuthorization.promotionRule: Only owner-produced literal statuses may be recorded. Active generation and dependency revisions must remain unchanged unless a separate task-scoped cutover authority exists.

mustChange: The deployable tracked set on /opt/wow-mini-program must match the selected immutable repository tree by SHA-256.
The current data owners must receive one bounded refresh attempt and persist their literal completed, partial or blocked result.
Ignored WeChat build output, local SWC compiler cache and project.private.config.json must not enter the backend deployment archive or remain on the server.
Project state, roadmap and remote runbook must describe the resulting production identity and data boundaries.
mustNotChange: Formal Active Manifest generation 41, its f50a SimC dependency, rollback Manifest and dormant 30555 Candidate identity.
PostgreSQL-only runtime mode, migration ledger, public route count, frontend source behavior and manual acceptance record.
Retained formal evidence and reviewed rollback material.
riskUnknown: External Blizzard, Raider.IO or community sources may complete only partially despite a successful service process.
A persistent gear-release timer may catch up after restoration, so Active pointer and timer backflow need fresh verification.
Tar-overlay deployment can retain or reintroduce ignored local files unless archive behavior is tested and remote residue is audited.
evidenceRequired: Pre-write disk, service, timer, migration, Active pointer and health snapshot plus a pg_restore-validated PostgreSQL custom backup.
Runtime file hash parity, service restart, PostgreSQL-only environment boundary and fail-closed data-health follow-up output.
Per-owner sync journals and persisted sync-state/health results, not only unit exit status.
Post-refresh Active/rollback/SimC identity, timers, failed units, disk, API canary and rollback paths.
RED/GREEN functional coverage for deployment archive exclusion and final local CR/Harness verification.

ownership.factOwner: server/deploy_lighthouse.sh owns transport exclusions; PostgreSQL cache stores own refreshed facts; server/data_health_followup.py may only schedule owner-safe actions.

engineeringHealth.reason: The task writes production data and restarts existing services, but uses a validated full backup, shared sync lock, stopped release-refresh timer, no-bootstrap deployment and immutable Active Manifest checks.

acceptanceEvidence: All deployable tracked files match one immutable Git tree and ignored local-only output/compiler cache is absent from the cloud project root.
The PostgreSQL migration ledger remains complete and the backend runs only in postgres_only mode after deployment.
WebSim, community templates and stat weights each have a terminal unit result plus owner-produced persisted status and checkedAt/refreshedAt evidence.
Active generation, Manifest/rollback revisions and bound SimC runtime remain unchanged; an available newer SimC remains report-only.
Loopback and public API canaries, timers, failed units, journals, disk and rollback material are freshly verified.

decisionLog.decision: The user explicitly requested updating the known cloud server code and data after repository alignment and residue cleanup.
Refresh owner jobs run sequentially behind the shared sync lock while wow-gear-release-refresh.timer is temporarily stopped; Active promotion and SimC update remain outside scope.

Functional archive and post-deploy extras probes proved ignored WeChat output, the local macOS SWC plugin cache and private configs were uploaded by tar overlay; the deployment exclusions are corrected test-first and the exact cloud residue is removed.
